item.title: Handle two workshop bookings for the same bench
item.context_text: A club accidentally gave two people the same equipment booking. One task can be split into short visits.
item.objective_text: Find a fair plan that respects time, equipment and drying constraints.
success_conditions: Find a fair plan that respects time, equipment and drying constraints.
Reserve the later slot for gluing

children.title: Read the workshop calendar
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Bench A has a clamp. Sessions are 4:00–4:45, 4:45–5:30 and 5:30–6:15. Both Iris and Dev received a confirmation for 4:00. No wet glue may stay on a shared bench.

questions.prompt: Which times have two confirmed users?
questions.explanation: The duplicate was for the first session.

questions.prompt: What prevents someone from leaving during a gluing job?
options: Wet glue cannot stay on the shared bench
questions.explanation: The rule applies to unattended wet work.

children.title: Hear what the users need
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: Dev can only stay until five. He needs thirty minutes to fit a shelf without glue. Iris needs a dry fit for fifteen minutes and a full forty minutes with glue later. She can come back after five.

questions.prompt: Who has the earlier finish limit?
questions.explanation: Dev can stay only until five.

questions.prompt: What lets Iris use a later slot?
options: Her project takes less than fifteen minutes
She can split fitting and gluing
questions.explanation: Iris can do a short fit early and return for the longer job.

children.title: Open the conversation
children.prompt_text: Both members are at the desk and are expecting the first slot.
children.instructions: Acknowledge the booking mistake. Explain briefly why you propose that Dev go first. Offer Iris a specific place in the schedule.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: We sent both of you the same confirmation. Could Dev start at four, since he needs to leave by five? Iris can use the last fifteen minutes for the dry fit, then come back after five.

children.title: Record the agreed allocations
children.prompt_text: Both users agree, and Iris chooses the full slot starting at 5:30.
children.instructions: Write one note the evening supervisor can follow. Give times, distinguish which task uses glue and say how to leave the bench at the end.
children.goal: Find a fair plan that respects time, equipment and drying constraints.
children.model_answer: Bench A is for Dev from four to four thirty for the shelf fitting. Iris will do her dry fit from four thirty to four forty-five. She will return for the full five thirty slot to glue and finish. Please check the bench is clean and no wet glue is left when she goes.

points.label: Reserve the later slot for gluing
